seo.title: Your first trip abroad | TripAgent
seo.description: Your first trip abroad, looked after end to end. The right flight, the right hotel, the visa filed for you: by a named advisor who stays on the line.

hero.headingHtml: Your first time abroad, made easy.
hero.lede: The visa, the connection, an airport you've never seen. You face none of it alone. A named advisor takes you through every step, and stays on the line.

intro.note: The destination isn't the daunting part. It's everything before it: the visa, the documents, the not-knowing. We carry that.
intro.statement: You bring the excitement. We carry the rest.
intro.lede: No stack of forms. No fear of getting one wrong. Tell your advisor where you'd love to go, and roughly when. They say plainly what's needed, then do it: the visa, the flights, the hotel. One person on WhatsApp, answering every question, until you're standing where you dreamed of standing.

cards.heading: Everything explained, plainly
cards.body: What a visa is. Why each document matters. How the connection works. What happens at immigration. Ask anything: a person answers, in your own words.

cards.heading: A hand through the unfamiliar bits
cards.body: Check-in, security, the gate, the transfer, the forms at the other end. We walk you through it beforehand, and we're a message away on the day.

cards.heading: One number, always reachable
cards.body: A delayed flight, a missed gate, a question in a place you don't know. Your advisor is on the same WhatsApp thread, day or night, and acts before it becomes a problem.

flights.heading: The easiest way there.
flights.lede: On a first long-haul, a simple route matters more than the cabin. We choose the gentlest journey, and explain each leg before you reach the airport.

items.bodyHtml: A direct flight where one exists: nothing to connect. Where it doesn't, one easy connection with comfortable margin, never a tight, anxious transfer.
The right cabin for the distance: premium economy or business on the overnight legs, so you land ready for day one, not recovering from the flight.
Seats together, the meal you prefer, and airport assistance arranged if an elderly traveller is flying for the first time too. The small asks that keep a long flight calm.
A clear itinerary in the thread, where to be, when, what each step looks like, so nothing at the airport takes you by surprise.

stays.heading: The right hotel for a first-timer.
stays.imageAlt: A well-located, welcoming hotel for a first trip abroad

cards.heading: Somewhere easy to find your feet
cards.body: A well-placed hotel where you step out and feel at ease: close to the sights, simple to reach from the airport, with staff used to first-time visitors. Not the cheapest dot on a map. The right place to find your confidence.

cards.heading: A transfer, and a room that's ready
cards.body: A private car from the airport, so there's no taxi to argue over after a long flight. Early check-in arranged where we can, so you can simply rest before the trip begins.

cards.heading: A hotel told to look after you
cards.body: We tell the hotel it's a first visit, so the front desk is ready with the small things that matter: directions, a good first dinner, what no guidebook tells you. And your advisor is always the easier first call.

signature.pullHtml: You step into a city you've only seen in pictures, and everything that worried you is already behind you.

visa.heading: The visa, held from start to stamp.
visa.lede: For most first-timers, the visa is the frightening part: the forms, the financials, the appointment, the fear of a refusal. This is where a person makes the difference. We don't send a checklist. We do it with you, and mostly for you.
items: We tell you plainly what your destination needs for an Indian passport: visa-free, visa-on-arrival, e-visa, or a consulate visa with an appointment.
We fill the form, write the cover letter, arrange the travel insurance, and tell you exactly which documents and financial papers to gather: with examples.
For consulate visas such as Schengen, we book the biometrics appointment, align it with your confirmed flights and hotels, and tell you what to expect on the day.
We file it and track it to passport return, and confirm current requirements before you travel. Any follow-up is ours to handle, not yours to worry about.
visa.imageAlt: Passport and travel documents being prepared for a first visa application

when.text: Begin early and the first trip is calm, not rushed. A consulate visa can take weeks: the sooner you tell us where you dream of going, the easier every step.

cta.heading: Plan your first trip abroad.
cta.lede: Tell us where you'd love to go, and roughly when. We'll explain it plainly, handle the visa, the flights and the hotel, and stay with you, every step, until you are home.
